title: Best Leggings (2026)
summary: The guide highlights five leggings that stand out for comfort, support, and durability, with Lululemon Wunder Under leading the pack.
method: Selected products were chosen from Tom’s Guide, CNET, TheFiltery, and Yahoo Shopping, prioritizing items mentioned by more than one source and covering a range of use cases.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no cost information is included.

products.name: Lululemon Wunder Under Leggings
why: The Wunder Under is highlighted by CNET as the best overall workout leggings for 2026.
Tom’s Guide lists it among the top Lululemon leggings for gym and running use.
products.desc: The Wunder Under is a lightweight, breathable pair made for active use. It offers a smooth fit and strong support but does not include pockets.
products.benefit: Picture a runner who needs lightweight, breathable fabric that moves with every stride. The Wunder Under delivers a smooth fit and excellent support, making it ideal for cardio and gym workouts. It outperforms other picks in overall comfort and support, as noted by CNET. The catch: it has no pockets.

products.name: Lululemon Align Leggings
why: Yahoo Shopping lists it as the best leggings with pockets for 2026.
It features two drop‑in side pockets and one interior waistband pocket.
products.desc: The Align leggings are made of 81% nylon and 19% Lycra, with high rise and drop‑in side pockets. They are known for comfort but do not emphasize high‑intensity performance.
products.benefit: Picture a commuter who needs pockets for a phone and keys. The Align leggings offer two side pockets and an interior waistband pocket, making them convenient for travel. They win over the Wunder Under in pocket availability, but they are less breathable for intense cardio. The catch: they are not designed for high‑intensity workouts.

products.name: Girlfriend Collective Leggings
why: TheFiltery reviews it as a durable, non‑toxic option made from recycled plastic bottles.
It is praised for long‑term support and squat‑proofness.
products.desc: The Girlfriend Collective leggings are made from recycled plastic bottles and are designed to be squat‑proof and supportive. They do not contain toxic chemicals but are not highlighted for pockets.
products.benefit: Picture a bodybuilder who wants a durable, non‑toxic pair that stays supportive through heavy lifts. The Girlfriend Collective leggings are squat‑proof and made from recycled materials, outperforming the Wunder Under in durability for heavy lifting. They are less breathable for cardio and lack pockets. The catch: they may not fit larger chests as well.
products.skip_if: You need pockets or high‑intensity cardio

verdict.line: Picture a runner who needs lightweight, breathable fabric that moves with every stride. The Wunder Under delivers a smooth fit and excellent support, making it ideal for cardio and gym workouts. Its main catch is that it lacks pockets, so you’ll need a separate bag for small items.
